the experiment definition and most lifecycle paths have no automated behavioral case yet; a runtime regression covers reweight-retirement event classification. Their broader delivery was verified by manual CLI QA on an isolated store (create, draft edit, start refused while disabled and at max_running, arm edit refused while running, reweight opening a segment, pause, resume, conclude, clone, the ordered event log, and agent writes refused while agent show and list succeed). Concluding with an arm stores the readout snapshot on the conclusion event and files one proposed promotion task; concluding with no arm files nothing and changes no configuration or repository file. The definition, concurrent-write and running-limit paths still need a wider public-boundary scenario

condition-trigger load-time checking and explain have no automated behavioral case yet; delivery was verified by manual CLI and tool QA on an isolated store (routine and auto-task conditions with an unknown field, a non-bool result, a computed tasks[...] index, no task-scope prefilter, matches(), an unguarded optional self field, a host scope and an over-size expression each refused per file naming the file, clause and line:column while every other definition loaded; explain over task and workspace scopes listing matches, closest misses and a clause tree with operand values, the CLI --json equal to the orbit.automation.explain tool output, and only the per-command audit row written; a pre-change binary refusing each condition file as an unknown field)

the experiment readout has no automated behavioral case yet; its delivery was verified by manual CLI, tool and HTTP QA on an isolated store with seeded assignments (per-arm estimates and intervals hand-checked, a sample-ratio mismatch withholding the verdict, collecting below min_sample, a winner past the horizon, a drift warning, forced and surface-conflict exclusions and open lagging outcomes counted, the shared versioned readout fields compared across tool, CLI and HTTP with web-only `cumulative` added by HTTP, and an unknown experiment or metric refused with 400 naming it), and those paths still need a public-boundary scenario

the Analytics › Experiments page and its list, show and conclude endpoints have no automated behavioral case yet; their delivery was verified by manual browser QA against a locally served dashboard (a running shadow experiment, a live experiment still collecting, and a concluded one past its horizon with a sample-ratio warning, each in the list with per-arm progress toward min_sample and in detail with arm cards, forest plot, cumulative series, per-complexity table, crew mix, health warnings and timeline, at desktop and 375px; an operator session on a running experiment shows the conclude form, and a concluded experiment shows the chosen arm and its promotion task) and by HTTP QA on an isolated store (list enrollment excludes forced assignments, show returns the event log, an unknown experiment is refused with 400 naming it, which the page renders as an error state, and the conclude route is operator-only and calls the same conclusion as the CLI), and those paths still need a public-boundary scenario
